MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The stainless washer assortment fits my history of buying clamps and electrical connectors: it gives me useful small parts for fastening and repairing things.",
    "The caliper would help me measure fittings before choosing repair parts, although SAE-only measurements make it less useful when my clamp sizes also include metric dimensions."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Grinding discs and marine grease require specific tools or projects that my purchases do not establish; buying repair supplies does not mean I need every kind of workshop consumable.",
    "The medical thermometer, garment cleaning kit, and robot vacuum do not address the fastening, joining, and inspection tasks reflected in my history.",
    "Gloves and cleanup towels could support repair work, but that indirect connection is not enough for me to choose them now, especially with uncertain glove fit or an unnecessary dispensing system."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions seem to treat broadly practical equipment as interchangeable with supplies for my particular repairs.",
    "They seem to assume that owning clamps and adhesives also means I have outdoor marking, grinding, or marine maintenance projects underway."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection is what an item lets me do with fittings and small parts: secure them, join them, inspect them, or measure them.",
    "Compatibility matters to me, including dimensions, measurement units, and whether I own the tool an accessory needs.",
    "I choose selectively when an item has a clear use; something that might eventually help with cleanup is less compelling than a directly useful repair part."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions partly recognized my practical repair interests but stretched them into specialized projects and unrelated equipment without a clear reason for me to need them."
}
